title: Garden
description: C7 (draft): the garden: typed facts about the owner's life with a valid-time and a transaction-time axis, provenance and expiry. `search` (active tier) returns full facts with ids, optionally `as_of` a past time; `pointers` (passive tier) returns at most three one-line pointers to fact ids and never fact text. `propose` writes a candidate into the seedbed, the day's records that `search` and `pointers` return marked `unprocessed` (and `disputed` when one conflicts with a current fact) until the night's processing; the night stage takes records with `seedbed_take` and hands them to the edge with `seedbed_done`, and the edge accepts each candidate on its own or queues contradictions and doubts for the owner (`digest`, `resolve`). `forget` marks seedbed records, which `search`, `pointers`, `seedbed_take` and `seedbed_done` then leave out until `undo` lifts the marks, and queues the current facts its refs reach for the night's reconciliation. `places_search` answers the places bed, typed places with per-attribute freshness, the owner's verdicts and the bed profile, apart from facts (ADR-0080). Secrets enter only as a vault reference. A miss is reported as C1 `garden_miss`. The daemon `ulei-garden serve` serves the operations in `x-methods`: each is `POST /v1/<name>` with the input as the JSON body over HTTP/1.1 on a unix socket, one request per connection; a `200` answer carries the output and any other status carries `Error` (`x-transport`, `x-error`, ADR-0047, ADR-0051, ADR-0055).

x-transport.protocol: HTTP/1.1 with JSON bodies over a SOCK_STREAM unix socket of at most 107 bytes, mode 0600, in a directory of the daemon's uid that no other user can enter; the daemon listens, any local caller connects
x-transport.request: `POST /v1/<name>` for each `x-methods` entry with the method input as the body
x-transport.response: `200` with the method output as the body; every other status with `Error` as the body
x-transport.connection: one request per connection; every read and write of a connection has a 5 s deadline
x-transport.peer_check: the daemon answers `403 forbidden` and closes a connection whose SO_PEERCRED uid differs from its own uid

as_of.description: Answer as of this Unix time.

private.description: Include private facts (only for the owner's own runtime).

no_miss.description: True queues no miss for a query that finds nothing, so no `garden_miss` carries its words, as for the candidates of the owner's forget; absent = false.

Fact.description: A fact with its validity interval.

valid_to.description: Valid until (Unix time); absent = still valid.

fact_id.description: Id of this fact version; pass it to pointers, digests and resolutions.

domain.description: Domain slug of the fact, if any.

expires_at.description: After this Unix time the fact is stale and must be re-checked; absent = no expiry.

pinned.description: In the pinned core profile (`ProposeRequest.pin`); absent = not pinned.

proof_count.description: 1 plus the `duplicate` proposals that named this fact.

recheck_before_acting.description: The fact's lifetime kind (`law`) must be re-checked before acting on it; absent = false.

unprocessed.description: A seedbed record the night has not processed yet; its `fact_id` is the record's ref `seed:<seq>`. Absent = false.

disputed.description: The record conflicts with a current fact of the same entity and attribute, `conflicts_with`, until the night's review. Absent = false.

conflicts_with.description: Id of the current fact a disputed record conflicts with.

lexical_only.description: True when the dense side is down and the facts come from the lexical side alone; absent = false.

ProposeRequest.description: Propose a fact to the edge for reconciliation.

entity.description: Entity id, or a name or alias of an existing entity; an unknown one creates an entity of `kind`. Absent: the edge refuses the candidate as `invalid` when it decides it.

attribute.description: Single-valued attribute the fact sets (e.g. `address`); a newer value closes the old one, an unsettled one goes to the digest.

valid_to.description: Valid until (Unix time); absent = still valid.

observed_at.description: When the source was observed (Unix time); absent = now.

confidence.description: Proposer's confidence in [0, 1]; below the garden's threshold the candidate goes to the digest. Absent = 1.

secret_ref.description: Vault reference of a secret the fact points to: `vault:` and a path without whitespace; the fact text must not contain the secret value.

private.description: Visible only to the owner's own runtime.

pin.description: Owner only: `true` pins the fact into the core profile, `false` unpins the current fact of the same entity and attribute; a pin change is an update, never a `duplicate`. From any other `source_kind`, or with `secret_ref`, the candidate is `invalid`. Absent: a version that closes a pinned version of the same entity and attribute inherits the pin.

ProposalStatus.description: Proposal status; `seeded`: written into the seedbed as an unprocessed record.

proposal_id.description: Proposal id; for `seeded` the record's ref `seed:<seq>`.

fact_id.description: Id of the fact written (`accepted`) or of the equal fact already held (`duplicate`).

conflicts_with.description: Id of the current fact a queued contradiction conflicts with, or that a `seeded` record disputes.

ProposalReason.description: Why a proposal was queued or rejected; `ambiguous_entity`: queued because the candidate's entity name could name more than one entity.

SourceKind.description: Kind of source; rank for reconciliation: owner > raw > internet > agent.

TtlKind.description: Type of a fact for its lifetime (the garden's TTL table, ADR-0044): `weather` 3 h; `never_cache` (open now, live arrivals) is never stored; `fx_rate`, `duty_pharmacy`, `news` 1 day; `price`, `availability`, `timetable` 7 days; `opening_hours`, `contacts` 30 days; `product` 60 days; `law` 90 days and re-checked before acting; `place` (existence, address of an institution) 180 days; `general` and `personal` never expire. Absent = `personal` for owner and raw sources, `general` otherwise.

PointersRequest.description: Passive tier: pointers for a request, without fact text.

k.description: At most this many pointers; default 3.

as_of.description: Answer as of this Unix time.

private.description: Include private facts (only for the owner's own runtime).

Pointer.description: A one-line pointer to a fact: says that a fact exists, not what it says.

fact_id.description: Fact id; `search` or a later lookup returns the text.

entity.description: Name of the entity the fact is about.

hint.description: One line, never the text: `there is a fact about <entity> (<kind>)` for a fact, `there is an unprocessed record about <entity> (<kind>)` or `(<kind>, disputed)` for a seedbed record.

unprocessed.description: Points to a seedbed record the night has not processed yet; `fact_id` is its ref `seed:<seq>`. Absent = false.

disputed.description: That record conflicts with a current fact until the night's review. Absent = false.

PointersResponse.description: Pointers above the garden's score threshold, best first; empty on a miss.

lexical_only.description: True when the dense side is down and the pointers come from the lexical side alone; absent = false.

DigestReason.description: Why a candidate waits for the owner; `ambiguous_entity`: the candidate's entity name could name any of the item's `entity_candidates`.

DigestRequest.description: List the open digest items, oldest first.

DigestItem.description: A candidate the edge did not accept on its own.

conflicts_with.description: Id of the current fact a contradiction conflicts with.

conflicting_fact.description: Text of that fact, for the owner.

queued_at.description: When the candidate was queued (Unix time).

entity_candidates.description: For `ambiguous_entity`: the existing entities the candidate's name could name; the owner picks one with `ResolveRequest.entity`.

ResolveAction.description: Owner's decision on a digest item: `accept` writes the candidate (closing a conflicting fact), `reject` drops it, `replace` writes `replacement` instead.

proposal_id.description: Proposal id of the digest item.

entity.description: For `accept` of an `ambiguous_entity` item: the chosen entity id, one of the item's `entity_candidates`.

EntityCandidate.description: An existing entity an ambiguous name could name.

DenseState.description: The dense side: `off` without the embedder, `ready`, or `down` while the embedder helper is restarted.

Health.description: The daemon's state for the operator and `ulei status`.

dense_error.description: Why the dense side is down; present only while `dense` is `down`.

failed_proposes.description: Proposes rolled back by a store failure since the daemon started.

unpublished_misses.description: Rows waiting in the miss outbox.

SeedbedTakeRequest.description: Night stage: the unprocessed seedbed records not forgotten, oldest first; reads only and leases nothing.

limit.description: At most this many records; default 50.

until.description: Only records written at or before this Unix time; absent = now.

after.description: Only records after this one, by `seq`; absent = from the oldest. A night stage that leaves a batch for the next night passes the last ref of that batch to take the next.

SeedRecord.description: An unprocessed seedbed record: one candidate of the day as it was written.

written_at.description: When the garden wrote the record (Unix time).

conflicts_with.description: Id of the current fact the record disputes; absent = not disputed.

SeedbedTakeResponse.description: A batch of unprocessed seedbed records.

candidates.description: The candidates the edge decides instead of the record's own; empty = the record is dropped. Absent = the record's own candidate.

SeedbedDoneRequest.description: Night stage: hand records to the edge and mark them processed, each in its own unit of work; an unknown or forgotten ref fails the call with `not_found` before any item is processed.

SeedbedOutcome.description: What the edge decided for one processed record; a record already processed answers its stored outcome.

outcomes.description: The answer for every candidate the edge decided, in order.

items.description: One outcome per item, in the request's order.

ForgetRequest.description: Forget records by ref, or with `undo` bring them back, in one unit of work. A seedbed record among the refs gets a mark and is forgotten while one of its marks is live, and marking a forgotten record adds no second live mark. For every ref the night's reconciliation queue gets one row per current fact whose `source_ref` is the ref or, for `seed:<seq>`, that a proposal of that record wrote. A `c8:` ref is only queued: the session journal holds its marks. An unknown seedbed ref fails the call with `not_found` and changes nothing.

refs.description: The records: `seed:<seq>`, `c8:<n>` or `c8:session:<id>`. An `archive:<id>` ref is refused: forget neither marks nor changes the archive.

reason.description: Why the owner asked to forget them; required without `undo`, unused with it.

provenance.description: The owner's command that marks or lifts: `s<session>-t<turn>-n<n>`, the turn that ran it and the `n` of that turn's prompt; `-n<n>` is absent until that turn is journaled.

undo.description: True lifts the live marks of the refs' seedbed records, keeping them with the lift's time and command, and removes the refs' queue rows the night has not taken; absent = false.

ForgetOutcome.description: What a `forget` changed for one ref.

marks.description: Seedbed marks written, or lifted with `undo`: 0 for a `c8:` ref and for a record already forgotten, or with `undo` not forgotten.

queue.description: Queue rows written, or removed with `undo`.

ForgetTakeRequest.description: Night stage: the rows of the forget queue the night has not taken, by `id`, ascending; reads only and leases nothing.

limit.description: At most this many rows; default 50.

after.description: Only rows whose `id` is greater; absent = from the first.

ForgetRow.description: One row of the forget queue: a current fact a forgotten ref reached when the owner forgot it.

ref.description: The forgotten ref that reached the fact.

marked_at.description: When the owner forgot the ref (Unix time).

queued_at.description: When the row was queued (Unix time).

ForgetTakeResponse.description: A batch of the forget queue.

ForgetDoneRequest.description: Night stage: clear queued facts, each row in its own unit of work: a fact still current is closed on the transaction axis with no new version, and the row is marked taken; a row already taken changes nothing. An unknown id fails the call with `not_found` before any row is cleared.

closed.description: True when this call closed the fact; false when it was no longer current or the row was taken before.

items.description: One outcome per id, in the request's order.
One outcome per ref, in the request's order.

PlacesSearchRequest.description: Search the places bed (ADR-0080 section 5): the filters, then the order by the owner's verdict, the vibe words, rating times the log of the review count, and distance. Distances are measured from `near`, else from the bed profile's `home`, and there is none without either. A stale attribute demotes and marks a place and never drops it; a place whose latest verdict is -1 or whose `cuisine` names a ban of the bed profile is not answered.

open_now.description: Keep the places that may be open at `local_time`: fresh `hours` that say closed drop a place, while stale, missing or unread `hours` keep it with `open` `probably_open` or `unknown`. Needs `local_time`; absent = false.

local_time.description: Wall-clock time at the places, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM`, against which `open_now` reads `hours`.

vibe.description: Words of the wanted atmosphere. The second ranking term counts their distinct stems found in a place's `vibe` and `cuisine` values and verdict note; absent = the term is 0 for every place.

PlacesFilters.description: Filters of `places_search`; a filter on an attribute a place does not have drops the place, and a stale value still counts as the place's value.

cuisine.description: Keep a place whose `cuisine` names one of these, compared after normalisation.

max_distance_m.description: Keep a place within this many metres of the point, `near` or else the profile's `home`. Needs a point.

min_rating.description: Keep a place whose `rating` is at least this; absent = the profile's `min_rating`, and no rating filter without one.

max_price_for_two.description: Keep a place whose `price_for_two` starts at or below this, in the profile's currency; absent = the profile's `budget_for_two`, and no budget filter without one.

status.description: Keep places of these statuses; absent = `active` and `candidate`.

PlaceStatus.description: Status of a place: `candidate` found by a search and not yet confirmed, `active` confirmed, `gone` closed for good or excluded, kept so it is not suggested again.

distance_m.description: Great-circle metres from the point; absent without a point or without the place's location.

maps_url.description: A map link to the place's point, or a map search for its name and address when it has no location.

marks.description: Why the place is demoted or needs a check; empty = none.

PlaceAttr.description: One attribute of a place with its own freshness.

value.description: Value as stored, in the key's value form.

checked_at.description: When the value was last checked against its source (Unix time).

age_days.description: Whole days from `checked_at` to the search.

stale.description: `checked_at` plus the key's `ttl_days` is before the search; always false for a key without a TTL.

PlaceVerdict.description: The owner's verdict on a place; it never goes stale.

verdict.description: 1 liked, 0 visited without a grade, -1 not again.

said_at.description: When the owner said it (Unix time).

source_ref.description: Reference to the message that carries it.

better_than.description: Id of a place the owner said this one beats.

OpenState.description: Answer of `open_now` for a place: `open` fresh `hours` say open at `local_time`; `probably_open` stale `hours` say open, check before going; `unknown` no `hours`, unread `hours`, or stale `hours` that say closed, check before going.

PlaceMark.description: A mark on a place: `stale` with `key` and `age_days`, one per stale attribute that demotes the place; `ban_risk` with `terms`, the bans of the bed profile its `warnings` name; `possible_duplicate` with `other`, a place within 75 m with a similar name that nobody has settled.

ErrorCode.description: Error class; its HTTP status: `invalid_request` 400 (the body is not the method input, or a `places_search` with `open_now` and no `local_time` or with `max_distance_m` and no point), `forbidden` 403, `unknown_method` 404, `not_found` 404 (a `resolve` of an unknown or closed item, a `seedbed_done` of an unknown or forgotten seedbed ref, a `forget` of an unknown seedbed ref, a `forget_done` of an unknown row), `replacement_refused` 409, `too_large` 413, `store_failed` 500.
